title: My favourite place in my town
context_es: La página web de tu clase de inglés publica textos cortos de los alumnos. Este mes el tema es «Mi lugar favorito de mi ciudad».
prompt_en: Your English class website wants short texts called 'My favourite place in my town'. Write your text.
points: what the place is and where it is
useful_language: It is near / next to / in the centre of …
tips_es: Para describir un lugar: *There is / There are* y adjetivos sencillos (*quiet, big, old*).
model_answer: My favourite place in my town is the old market. It is in the centre, next to the river. There are about thirty small shops, and you can buy fresh fruit, bread and flowers there. There is also a café with tables outside. I usually go on Saturday morning with my sister. I like it because it is always full of people, but everybody is friendly and nobody is in a hurry.
